### Confession Leads to Connection
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-january-2-2025.html
Passage: Isaiah 59:2
Points:
- Unconfessed sin and hidden guilt produce anxiety, misery, and spiritual exhaustion.
- Keeping busy or masking mistakes does not resolve the separation caused by sin.
- Guilt acts like accumulated garbage that cuts off our sense of connection with God.
- Believers must keep short accounts with the Lord by confessing wrongdoing daily.
- Bringing our failures into the light allows God's grace to cover and restore us.

### The Women of Christmas
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-dec-7-2007-11561285.html
Passage: Isaiah 59:1
Points:
- God intentionally honored broken, unlikely women by placing them in Jesus' genealogy.
- Past failures, scandal, or outcast status cannot keep God from saving and using someone.
- No person has sunk into a pit so deep that God's hand cannot reach them.
- Christ came to seek out the weak and redeem the undeserving for His glory.

### The Gospel and Prayer
Author: Donald Whitney
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gospel-and-prayer
Passage: Isaiah 59:2
Points:
- Universal prayer studies overlook the reality that human sin separates people from God.
- God does not pledge to hear or answer prayers based on mere human sincerity or crisis.
- Approaching God without Christ implies that the Savior's sacrifice was unnecessary.
- Only faith in the person and work of Jesus removes the barrier between God and man.
- The Holy Spirit transforms prayer from a burdensome obligation into a filial desire.
